changes: Direct conversion for ordinary ASCII method names; ASCII word tokenization avoids Unicode setup and general Lodash helper wrappers.
Retain upstream Unicode word boundaries, Latin-1/Extended-A transliteration and grapheme-aware capitalization in a lazily loaded module.
Remove dynamic Function-based global discovery and duplicate lowercasing/whole-word symbol arrays.
Handle zero BigInts without division by a number, and recognize boxed Symbols without consulting Symbol.toStringTag.
Self-contained declarations and CommonJS/native ESM default export; no runtime dependencies or result cache.
